description.zh: 用一块可多行增长的输入区收集长文本，如简介、备注、留言与反馈。 支持手动或自动增高，常配字数统计与提交按钮；超出上限时计数变红提醒， 内容换行显示而非溢出截断。
description.en: A growing multi-line field for long text — bios, notes, messages and feedback. It grows manually or automatically, usually paired with a counter and submit button; the count turns red past the limit and content wraps instead of clipping.

use_when.zh: 收集简介、备注、留言等多段落长文本
use_when.en: Long-form text like bios, notes and messages

use_when.zh: 用户需要换行组织内容结构
use_when.en: Users need line breaks to structure content

use_when.zh: 字数有限制，需要实时统计反馈
use_when.en: Character limits need a live counter

avoid_when.zh: 单行短字段（姓名、邮箱），用 input 更紧凑
avoid_when.en: Short single-line fields — an input is more compact

avoid_when.zh: 需要加粗、标题等格式，用富文本编辑器
avoid_when.en: Formatting like bold and headings — use a rich-text editor

avoid_when.zh: 结构化输入（键值对、标签），用专用控件
avoid_when.en: Structured data like key-value pairs — use dedicated controls

note.zh: 固定行数内滚动，布局稳定
note.en: Fixed rows scroll internally — stable layout

note.zh: 随内容增长，适合聊天与评论框
note.en: Grows with content — chat and comment boxes

note.zh: 右下角实时字数，超限变红
note.en: Live counter bottom-right, red past the limit

notes.zh: 基础样式与 input 一致但多行：min-h 固定起点，resize-y 允许拖拽增高； 自动增高用 field-sizing: content（或 JS 监听 input 设置 scrollHeight）。 字数统计用 value.length 对比 maxLength，超限切换红色并阻止继续提交。
notes.en: Base styling matches input but multi-line: a min-h starting point and resize-y for manual growth; autosize via field-sizing: content (or JS setting height from scrollHeight on input). The counter compares value.length against maxLength, turning red past the limit and blocking submit.

basic.zh: 创建一个多行输入框组件，支持标签、字数统计和提交按钮。
basic.en: Create a textarea component with a label, character counter and submit button.

design.zh: 创建多行输入框组件。要求：min-h 四行起点、可拖拽纵向增高；右下角实时字数统计 （超过上限变红）；下方提交按钮在为空或超限时禁用；聚焦 accent 描边；深浅色一致。
design.en: Create a textarea component. Requirements: four-row min height, vertically resizable; live counter bottom-right turning red past the limit; a submit button disabled when empty or over limit; accent focus ring; consistent in light/dark.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Textarea：受控 value + maxLength；自动增高监听 onInput 将 height 置为 auto 再取 scrollHeight（或用 field-sizing: content）；计数 value.length / maxLength，接近上限预警色、超限红；提交按钮 disabled 条件为 空或超限；resize-y + max-h 防止无限增高。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind Textarea: controlled value + maxLength; autosize by setting height to auto then scrollHeight on input (or field-sizing: content); counter of value.length / maxLength with a warning tint near the limit and red past it; submit disabled when empty or over limit; resize-y + max-h to cap growth.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现多行输入框组件。

先检查现有表单组件与 Design Token，保持风格一致。
要求：
- 受控多行输入，支持自动增高与手动拖拽
- 实时字数统计，超限变红并禁用提交
- 聚焦描边与无障碍标注（label 关联）
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a textarea component in the current project.

Inspect existing form components and design tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Controlled multi-line input with autosize and manual resize
- Live character counter, red past the limit with submit disabled
- Focus ring and accessibility labels
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No new dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 输入多行内容，观察字数与尺寸变化。
task.en: Enter several lines and inspect length and sizing behavior.

checks.zh: 标签与字数限制始终可见，不能只写在占位符中。
checks.en: Keep the label and length limit visible beyond the placeholder.

checks.zh: 调整高度时避免遮挡后续操作。
checks.en: Keep later actions reachable as the field grows.
